messages.author: 9c1a93cd557f488e
messages.subject: Error message
parts:
Hi
Does anyone know how to correct this error message?
"Error in plot.new() : figure margins too large"
I used par(mfrow = c(1,1))
What does it mean I am doing wrong? Do i have too many variables?
I am trying to run pairs()
Is there a way to run pairs() choosing only certain columns of my data set?
thanks

messages.author: 8d1674b7b16af1b1
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: Error message
parts:
I think your interpretation is correct: you’re asking R to put more variables onto the plot than it has space for.  You have at least two options.

1. You could create a larger graphics canvas to accommodate everything (e.g. using another graphics device like pdf)
2. You could plot only the columns that you’re interested in.

For option 2, you could select the columns manually, e.g. pairs(x[ , c(“column I want”, “another column I want”)]

Alternatively, the latest version of R, version 3.2, lets you use the horInd and verInd arguments to the pairs function (horizontal and vertical indices) to select  the columns you want by number, e.g. pairs(x, horInd = c(1, 3, 17), verInd = c(1, 3, 17))

Dave

messages.author: 8c8f0ca54c4a2459
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: Error message
parts:
It is possible that you have figure margins or some other graphical variable set from previous code. To reset your drawing device, and set these variables back to defaults, run:

dev.off()
dev.new()
​
